title: Count Equal and Divisible Index Pairs
description: Count pairs of indices `i < j` for which `nums[i] == nums[j]` and the product `i * j` is divisible by positive integer `k`. Input: `nums` and `k`. Output: the number of qualifying pairs.
hints: Sort or count values once, then process each candidate in a single pass.
Check duplicates, all-equal inputs, and boundary values for `k`.
